status: Completed substantive direction review and three-page working pitch. Qualified valuation SHORT selected as current candidate; no proven trading alpha or winning probability.

root_decision.working_recommendation: SHORT, qualified valuation thesis for competition review
root_decision.thesis: Intel can recover operationally while its equity offers insufficient compensation for manufacturing and cyclical risk at the entry price. The existing funded forecast supports a lower end-2026 planning value than the dated quote.
root_decision.fair_value_date: 2026-12-31 planning reference, not a 2030 target or predicted price-convergence date
root_decision.why_direction_selected_now: A fundamental valuation opinion can be a legitimate directional competition candidate without exact consensus, a guaranteed catalyst or positive price-only unhedged short PnL in every future year. Our higher operating-risk allowance supports the bearish stance; that remains a judgment rather than proven mispricing.
root_decision.limits_on_selection: Risk-adjusted underperformance has not been established by a specified hedged trade. No counter-long, hedge ratio, broker borrow/carry, margin return or portfolio alpha is modeled. Do not subtract the operating discount rate from shareholder CAGR and label the difference alpha.
root_decision.primary_counterargument: The central 2030 value is $67.58, above the $58.28 entry, implying 3.63% annual long price appreciation and a $9.30 price-only short loss before carry. Risk maturation raises the conditional 2030 value to $76.86 and long price CAGR to 6.89%.
root_decision.risk_sensitivity: At 10% operating discount, unchanged central cash supports $60.09 at end-2026; the dated quote matches about 10.17846%. The short view is materially exposed to the risk assumption.
what_is_not_the_thesis: Intel unit-share loss automatically means declining units
A new LONG earned by adding back compensation in EPS
root_decision.old_short_draft_status: Old early-convergence PDF remains historical and superseded. This new working pitch does not reinstate its unsupported timing claim.
root_decision.new_draft_status: Three-page review draft with business overview, recommendation, forecasts, horizon economics, countercases, falsifiers and sources. Not submitted; no claim of final competition readiness.

new_research_findings: TrendForce primary chart reconciles Intel unit-share loss with roughly 17.6% unit growth at 40% total-market growth; our 20% unit assumption is consistent with that mechanism.
New public aggregate FCF table already anticipates negative 2027 and modest positive 2028 cash. Own-versus-public cash comparison requires compensation/minority/partner adjustments.
Current mature policy implies roughly 21% incremental after-tax operating returns. Weak ramp cash is not evidence of permanent poor returns.
Asset-cohort consistency and TSMC/Intel evidence do not justify deleting capital spending or replacing the 0.80 host capital coefficient.
Fair cash-income controls raise 2030 value by less than $1; current APV cash at par already values fair cash returns, so no double-count uplift is justified.
Refreshed November 4 closing price lowers the central planning-value gap to 24.39%; the maturation control gap is 14.26%. Neither is a guaranteed realized short return.
rule_interpretation: The official rules require a clear LONG or SHORT based on 3-5-year fundamentals and judgment. They do not explicitly require guaranteed convergence, wholly original facts or a prescribed return. This does not establish that judges will accept any particular implementation or weaker horizon economics.
